title: User
description:
A User is the product-layer projection of an Operational Person AND the identity/login subject for auth. Like every Product Core primitive it is DERIVED, never hand-authored — the product-core-materializer projects it from the operational People primitives and the product surfaces.

The `person` mapping names the Operational Person it projects (defaults to `name`). The `identity` facet is genuinely new, product-level information with no operational home: it names which field authenticates the subject, so product/api auth middleware and product/ui sign-in surfaces know what to use. `identity` is a configured product fact, not derived.

name.description: The PascalCase name of the user.

person.description: The Operational Person this user projects. Defaults to matching `name` when omitted.

fields.description: The fields that describe this user, projected from the Person's Attributes.

actions.description: The actions that can be performed on this user.

identity.description: Configured auth facet — names the field(s) that authenticate this subject. Product-level information with no operational home; configured at the product surface, not derived.

identifier.description: The field whose value authenticates the subject (the login identifier).

verified.description: Whether the identifier must be verified before it can authenticate.
